# netbox_tunnel (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox tunnel (`/api/vpn/tunnels/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_tunnel" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_tunnel" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/vpn/tunnels/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `encapsulation` (String) Encapsulation. Valid values: `ipsec-transport`, `ipsec-tunnel`, `ip-ip`, `gre`, `wireguard`, `openvpn`, `l2tp`, `pptp`.
- `group_id` (Number) ID of the Tunnel Group (`netbox_tunnel_group`).
- `ipsec_profile_id` (Number) ID of the Ipsec Profile (`netbox_ipsec_profile`).
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `planned`, `active`, `disabled`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `terminations_count` (Number) Terminations Count.
- `tunnel_id` (Number) Tunnel Id.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
